lessons.description: Greet people, say thank you and sorry, and ask someone's name

grammar.title: A 是 B — 'A is B'
grammar.note: 是 links two nouns: 我是学生 = I am a student. Put 不 before 是 to say 'is not': 她不是老师. Don't use 是 before adjectives: say 我很好, not 我是好.

grammar.title: Yes/no questions with 吗
grammar.pattern: 你是老师吗？— 是。/ 不是。
grammar.note: Add 吗 to the end of a statement to make a yes/no question. Answer by repeating the verb (是 / 不是). 呢 asks 'and you?': 我很好，你呢？

grammar.title: Saying your name with 叫
grammar.pattern: 你叫什么名字？— 我叫王明。
grammar.note: 叫 means 'to be called'. 什么 ('what') stays where the answer goes: 你叫什么名字？ → 我叫王明。 Chinese question words never move to the front.

sentences.en: Hello! My name is Wang Ming.
I'm a student; he is a teacher.
Excuse me, are you Teacher Li?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.zh: 你好！我叫王明。你叫什么名字？
dialogue.en: Hi! I'm Wang Ming. What's your name?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 你好！我叫李月。你是学生吗？
dialogue.en: Hi! I'm Li Yue. Are you a student?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Yes, I'm a student. And you?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 我也是学生。我们是同学！
dialogue.en: I'm a student too. We're classmates!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.zh: 认识你我也很高兴。再见！
dialogue.en: Nice to meet you too. Bye!

lessons.description: Count to a hundred, say your age and ask for a phone number
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 几 / 多少 / 岁

grammar.title: Numbers 1–100
grammar.note: Build numbers like maths: 十一 = 10+1, 二十 = 2×10, 二十五 = 2×10+5. 100 is 一百. 0 is 零, used in phone numbers and room numbers.

grammar.title: Asking age: 几岁 / 多大
grammar.pattern: 你几岁？— 我八岁。/ 你今年多大？— 我二十岁。
grammar.note: Use 几岁 for young children (under about ten) and 多大 for teens and adults. The answer needs no 是: 我二十岁, not 我是二十岁.

grammar.title: 两 vs 二, and the measure word 个
grammar.pattern: 两个朋友 · 第二 · 十二
grammar.note: Before a measure word, 2 is 两: 两个人. Use 二 when counting, in 十二 / 二十, and in phone numbers. Numbers need a measure word before a noun; 个 is the most common.

sentences.en: How old are you this year?

sentences.zh: 我的手机号是一三九零八六七五四二一。

sentences.en: There are thirty students in our class.

dialogue.en: I'm nineteen too! What's your mobile number?

dialogue.speaker: B

lessons.description: Name family members and say how many people are in your family
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 有 / 没有 / 的 / 都

grammar.title: 有 / 没有 — have, not have
grammar.pattern: 我有一个哥哥。我没有妹妹。
grammar.note: 有 means 'to have' (also 'there is'). Its negative is always 没有 — never 不有. 你有…吗？ asks 'do you have…?'

grammar.title: 家有 + number + 口人
grammar.pattern: 你家有几口人？— 我家有五口人。
grammar.note: 口 is the measure word for counting people in a family. Use 几 for the question.

grammar.title: 的 for 'my / his', and 都 'all'
grammar.pattern: 我的妈妈 / 我妈妈 · 我们都是学生。
grammar.note: 的 shows possession. With close family you can drop it: 我妈妈. 都 ('all, both') goes before the verb: 他们都是老师, never 都他们.

sentences.en: How many people are in your family?

sentences.zh: 我家有四口人：爸爸、妈妈、哥哥和我。
sentences.en: There are four of us: Dad, Mom, my older brother and me.

sentences.zh: 我没有姐姐，我有一个妹妹。
sentences.en: I don't have an older sister; I have a younger sister.

sentences.zh: 他们有两个孩子，一个儿子，一个女儿。
sentences.en: They have two children, a son and a daughter.

sentences.zh: 我爷爷和奶奶都是老师。
sentences.en: My grandpa and grandma are both teachers.

sentences.zh: 那个小孩儿是你弟弟吗？
sentences.en: Is that little kid your younger brother?

lessons.description: Say days, dates and birthdays, and talk about years
lessons.grammarLabel: Pattern: 年 月 日 / 星期几

grammar.title: Dates go big → small
grammar.pattern: 二零二六年十一月九日 / 十一月九号
grammar.note: Say year, then month, then day: …年…月…日. In speech 号 replaces 日: 九号. Years are read digit by digit: 二零二六年 (èr líng èr liù nián).

grammar.title: Days of the week: 星期 + number
grammar.pattern: 星期一 … 星期六，星期日 / 星期天
grammar.note: Monday to Saturday are 星期一 to 星期六. Sunday is 星期日 or, in speech, 星期天. Ask with 星期几？

grammar.title: Time words before the verb
grammar.pattern: 我明天去北京。/ 明天我去北京。
grammar.note: Time words (今天, 明年, 星期六) go before the verb, either before or after the subject, never at the end of the sentence as in English.

sentences.zh: 今天十一月九号，星期一。
我的生日是五月二十日。
我去年八岁，今年九岁了。
sentences.en: I was eight last year; I'm nine now.

lessons.description: Tell the time and talk about parts of the day

grammar.title: Clock time: 点 + 分 / 半
grammar.pattern: 八点 · 八点十分 · 八点半
grammar.note: 点 is the hour, 分 the minutes. 半 is half past: 八点半 = 8:30. 2 o'clock is 两点, not 二点.

grammar.title: Part of day before the clock time
grammar.pattern: 早上七点 · 下午三点半 · 晚上十点
grammar.note: Chinese goes from big to small: part of the day first, then the hour. 下午三点 = 3 p.m.

grammar.title: 什么时候 — when?
grammar.pattern: 你什么时候回家？— 我六点回家。
grammar.note: 什么时候 asks 'when'. Like all question words it stays where the answer goes: the time slot before the verb.

sentences.en: I get up at seven in the morning.
He arrives at 2:50 in the afternoon.
I waited for you for half an hour!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.en: What time is it now?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Eleven forty.

dialogue.en: Are you free at noon? Let's eat together.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.en: Sure. When shall we go?

dialogue.speaker: A

dialogue.speaker: B

At noon he eats at school.

lines.zh: 他下午五点回家，晚上十点睡觉。
